besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two main clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n nuweling kon begin boer / het die gemeenskap sterk gebly).
besluite.rede: The comma is required by AWS 2017; the inverted 'het die gemeenskap' still ties the second clause to the fronted 'Omdat', so the meaning does not move and no protected wording is touched.
